structured_output.what_is_happening: JERRY is a pump.fun coin that migrated to PumpSwap about 21 minutes ago. Its all-time high price (0.00112) works out to about $1.12M market cap. It has since crashed about 79% to about $236k, including -75% in the last 5 minutes. It still shows heavy transaction counts: 1,344 buys and 1,074 sells in m5, and about 2,200 unique buyers and 2,180 unique sellers overall. The average trade is tiny, about $9.50 (110k volume over 11.5k transactions). There are no socials, website, DexScreener profile or paid promotion. The LP is 100% burned, mint and freeze are renounced, and holders are widely spread (top 10 about 7% excluding the AMM). The rule fired on the volume spike during the crash.

narrative.description: Generic 'JERRY' name (probably Tom & Jerry or mouse imagery). The packet shows no project story, links or community. Attention seems to come from launch and migration momentum only.
narrative.why_spreading: A fast bonding-curve fill and a spike to about $1.1M drew pump.fun traders. After that came a sharp dump. Nothing in the packet suggests an outside catalyst.

token_connection.competing_tokens: Nine dead JERRY/Jerry tokens (Sleepy Jerry, Mouseman, Jerry Kassar, etc.). None is active.

authenticity.evidence: Broad unique-buyer and holder counts (~2,600) and a low top-10 share point to real participation. But the average trade is only about $9.50, which suggests many micro or bot transactions inflate the count. The top_entrapment_trader_pct of 0.78 is high. The -79% drop from ATH within minutes looks like early buyers or insiders dumping. There are no paid boosts or call-channel signals.
authenticity.uncertainty: Without trade-level or wallet-flow data, it is unclear whether the transaction count is organic or a volume bot. It is also unclear who sold into the crash.

structural_risks: Down about 79% from ATH within 20 minutes, with heavy overhead supply from people who bought higher

No socials or community to support a recovery
$43k liquidity against a $236k market cap; big sells move price hard

Reclaiming 2x ($470k) is only about 40% of the prior ATH, so the +100% target is reachable if the dip gets bought.

structured_output.thesis: A post-migration blow-off that has already happened: $1.1M ATH, then about -79% within minutes, and the trigger fired on the crash volume. Clean structure makes a liquidity rug unlikely (LP burned), but there is no narrative or socials and a lot of trapped supply sits above. The more likely path is slow bleeding or chop, not a reclaim to $470k. A bounce is possible, but the odds are below a typical early coin with momentum.
